voice.name: birthright Help
voice.greeting: Hi there. You're speaking with birthright Help. I'm trained on this platform and ready to assist — you can ask for a human at any time.
voice.human_handoff: I'll flag this for the human team at the Foundation. They typically reply within one business day at support@birthright.live.
voice.fallback: I'm not sure about that one. Want me to flag it for a human at the Foundation?
voice.tone: warm, plainspoken, never clinical, never pushy

entries.answer: You can sign in without a password using a Magic Link. Go to https://birthright.live, tap Sign In, enter your email and choose Magic Link — we'll email you a one-click sign-in. If you originally joined via Google, the 'Continue with Google' button works too. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam and try a different browser.
entries.follow_up_label: Is that what you were looking for?

entries.answer: birthright accounts are personal — workshops, AI wallet, and partner tiers are tied to a single member. We don't have a couples plan yet, but your partner can create their own free account at birthright.live. If you'd like a 'shared household' feature, send a note and we'll add your voice to the roadmap.
entries.follow_up_label: Did that answer your question?

entries.answer: The five leather-engraved patches live in the Founder Collection at /equip. They're hand-engraved to order by 7C's Farmstead in 2–4 weeks. Each patch is $10 plus shipping. You can also buy the full set of five as a bundle for $40 (saves $10 versus buying each individually). Click any patch card and tap 'Buy on 7C's Farmstead →' to order direct from the artisan.
entries.follow_up_label: Want a direct link to the patches?

entries.answer: Yes — the full set of five engraved patches is offered as a bundle for $40 (vs $50 if you buy each individually). Open the bundle in the Founder Collection at /equip and tap 'Order direct' to send the order through 7C's Farmstead with shipping calculated at checkout on their site.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to take you there?

entries.answer: Patches are made to order by 7C's Farmstead, so lead time is typically 2–4 weeks. Shipping cost is calculated at checkout on 7C's site based on your address. If you need a patch by a specific date, mention it in the order notes and 7C's will tell you whether the timeline works.
entries.follow_up_label: Anything else about the patches?

patterns: does birthright make money on patches
entries.answer: On patches, birthright is set up as an affiliate of 7C's Farmstead — they remit 15% of every birthright-attributed sale to the Foundation, reconciled quarterly. The buyer pays the same $10 (or $40 bundle) plus shipping either way; the Foundation's share comes out of 7C's margin, not on top of the listed price.
entries.follow_up_label: Want to know about the broader revenue framework?

entries.answer: Artists progress through five tiers — Emerging, Sustaining, Established, Thriving, Flourishing — based on rolling 12-month birthright-attributed revenue. Each tier carries an inbound % (you earn from referred sales) and a small outbound % (you contribute back to the ecosystem). See the full breakdown at /partner/artist. Tier transitions take effect on the 1st of the following month.
entries.follow_up_label: Want to know what tier you're currently at?

entries.answer: AI features (Concierge, research collab, vendor PDM) draw from your AI wallet. We charge 1.5× the underlying provider cost — the extra 50% directly supports the Foundation. Top up from your Profile → AI Wallet at packs of $10/$25/$50/$100, or enable auto-recharge so you never get blocked mid-conversation. Anonymous use of public assistants is free; only logged-in members are billed.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to take you to your AI Wallet?

entries.answer: Artists get paid via Stripe Connect. Go to /partner/payout-method, click 'Connect with Stripe' and complete the onboarding (bank details + ID verification — runs entirely on Stripe's side). Once connected, the Admin Bulk Pay tool can transfer pending payouts directly to your bank. You can switch between Stripe Connect and manual wire/PayPal at any time on the same page.
entries.follow_up_label: Did that help?

entries.answer: Approved Research partners can publish artifacts (practitioner briefs, peer-reviewed papers, summaries) from their Partner Studio. Drafts stay private until you set status to 'published'. Each artifact accepts a cover image, abstract, full text URL, DOI, and category tags. Apply at /partner/apply if you don't have a Research profile yet.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to open the application?

entries.answer: Founding Membership is a one-time contribution that supports the Foundation's earliest years and unlocks the Founding Journal, the Founder Collection patches, and lifetime access to member workshops. Details and tiers are at /join. We're not running open enrollment year-round — when memberships are paused, you can still join the waitlist.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to take you to /join?

entries.answer: Live and on-demand workshops are at /practice. Open ones show 'Register' on each card — your registration creates a calendar invite and adds the workshop to your Profile. If a workshop is full, you can join the waitlist; we release seats as people drop out.
entries.follow_up_label: Looking for a specific topic?

entries.answer: We honor account deletion requests within 30 days. Email support@birthright.live from the address on your account with the subject 'Delete my account' — we'll confirm receipt, anonymize any public artifacts you authored (or leave them up with your byline removed, your choice), and erase personally identifiable data.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to flag this for a human?

entries.answer: Of course — email support@birthright.live and a human at the Foundation will get back to you, usually within one business day. If you'd like, share what you're working through and I can include it in the handoff note so they have context.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to draft a quick handoff note?

entries.answer: birthright Foundation exists on a single thesis: secure connection is everyone's birthright. We work with clinicians, artists, and patrons to make the science and practice of relational repair both visible and affordable. The platform is part publishing house, part artist economy, part practitioner network. Start at /practice or /research to see the work.
entries.follow_up_label: Want a tour?

entries.answer: Workshop and membership refunds are case-by-case within 30 days of purchase — email support@birthright.live with your order number and a sentence on what didn't fit, and we'll make it right. Patch orders go through 7C's Farmstead directly; refunds for those are governed by their custom-order terms.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to flag a refund request to a human?

entries.answer: Every active partner has a referral code. Share your code (or your gallery URL — every visit through a /api/r/{code} link drops a 30-day attribution cookie). Sales attributed to you pay an inbound percentage based on your tier (3–5% for Artists; partner tiers vary). Your code is on your Partner Studio dashboard.
entries.follow_up_label: Want to see your referral code?

entries.answer: Thank you for the impulse. The cleanest way to support the work right now is through Founding Membership at /join — a one-time contribution that funds the Foundation's earliest years. We're also happy to receive larger directed gifts (estates, sponsorships, scholarship funds); email support@birthright.live and a human will respond personally.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to take you to /join?

entries.answer: We don't currently run open recruitment — the Foundation is small and grows by invitation. If you'd like to be considered for future practitioner or partnership roles, email support@birthright.live with a short note about your background and what calls you to the work. We keep these on file and reach out when fit emerges.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to flag this for a human?

entries.answer: Workshop sponsorship and scholarships go through /sponsor — you can either fund a named workshop ($500–$5,000 depending on cohort size) or contribute to the general scholarship pool, which the Foundation matches at 25%. Larger directed sponsorships (named cohorts, research briefs) are arranged directly with the team.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to take you to /sponsor?

entries.answer: For press, podcast, or feature requests, email support@birthright.live with the outlet, your timeline, and what you'd like to cover. The Foundation does selective interviews — typically prioritizing outlets aligned with practitioner education over consumer wellness content.
entries.follow_up_label: Want to send a quick note?

entries.answer: We collect the minimum needed to run the platform — your account email, what you've purchased, and the workshops you've registered for. We never sell or share personal data. Full privacy details are at /privacy. For GDPR/CCPA data requests, email support@birthright.live with the subject 'Data request' and we'll respond within 30 days.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to flag a data request?

entries.answer: You can buy any item or workshop seat as a gift — at checkout, put the recipient's name and email in the order notes and we'll personalize the welcome. For patches via 7C's Farmstead, mention the recipient's shipping address in their order form. We don't yet have a dedicated gift-card SKU, but it's on the roadmap.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to flag a gift card request?

entries.answer: Quick tour: /practice is where you'll find workshops and the on-demand library. /research holds practitioner briefs and peer-reviewed papers. /gallery is the artist economy — paintings, photography, mixed media — every purchase carries a 20% Foundation patronage. /equip is the storefront, including the Founder Collection patches. /join is how you become a Founding Member.
entries.follow_up_label: Want a deeper tour of any one of those?

entries.answer: Amanda Reagan is the executive director of the Birthright Foundation — she leads operations and partnerships and is a long-time advocate of attachment-informed community work. She's currently the foundation's only standing officer; the /lead page also shows three placeholder bios illustrating the seats the foundation is actively building toward.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to take you to the leadership page?

entries.answer: Amanda Reagan is the current executive director and the foundation's standing officer. The /lead page also shows three placeholder bios (Board Chair, Director of Community Stewardship, Research Advisor) that illustrate the seats the foundation is actively building toward — those positions aren't filled yet. As the board fills out, real bios replace the placeholders.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to take you to the leadership page?

entries.answer: birthright is an educational foundation built on one conviction: secure bonds are everyone's birthright. We publish practitioner research, run small in-person and online workshops on attachment-informed relating, support an artist economy of partners producing aligned goods and creative work, and host a community of facilitators, researchers, vendors, and stewards. The full mission and education structure live at /about.
entries.follow_up_label: Want a tour of any specific part?

patterns: how do i become a partner
entries.answer: Anyone can apply to become a birthright partner — we have six tracks: Vendor, Community, Research, Facilitator, Artist, and Steward. Start at /partner/apply, tell us which track fits your work, and a steward will follow up within a few days. You can see live examples of each track at /partner and the type comparison + tier structure at /partner/types.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to open the application?

patterns: what kinds of partners are there
entries.answer: There are six partner tracks at birthright: Vendor (makers, goods, services), Community (groups, congregations, podcasts amplifying the work), Research (briefs and longitudinal studies), Facilitator (workshop-leading practitioners), Artist (visual and creative work), and Steward (mentors and witnesses in established circles). Full comparison + tier structure lives at /partner/types.
entries.follow_up_label: Want me to take you to the comparison page?

patterns: how do i review as counsel
entries.answer: Fastest, cheapest workflow if you're outside counsel: ask Birthright to email you `LEGAL_BRIEFING_FOR_COUNSEL.docx` and `00a-counsel-user-guide.docx`. Redline in Word with Track Changes and email the marked-up file back to legal@birthright.live. Our Executive Director does every platform click for you — you never need to log in for a normal review pass. Full per-function fast-path table lives in the Counsel User Guide.
entries.follow_up_label: Show my platform credentials anyway

patterns: how do i add a redline
how do i propose a change
entries.answer: Cheapest: mark up the .docx we sent you with Track Changes and email it to legal@birthright.live — admin transcribes it in ~30 seconds per redline. You avoid platform-typing time. If you'd rather do it in-app: sign in as counsel, open /admin/legal/ratifications, pick the doc, and use the 'Add redline' form (section + quoted text + suggested replacement + rationale).
entries.follow_up_label: Which files should I be downloading?

entries.answer: You never touch the platform to ratify. Send one email: 'We ratify <doc> at v<N> with the redlines applied on <date>. — <Firm>'. Admin marks it on the platform, records your firm name, and the public draft banner disappears automatically. New ratifications also appear on the public RSS feed at /api/legal/history.rss.
entries.follow_up_label: Where do users see the change log?

patterns: when will i know if the redlines were accepted
entries.answer: You'll receive an automated email the moment admin applies your redlines. Subject reads e.g. 'Roundtrip applied · Terms of Service · 4 accepted, 1 rejected.' Full per-doc history is at /admin/legal/ratifications → doc → Roundtrip history — but you don't need to check the platform; the email itself has the numbers.
entries.follow_up_label: How do I ratify a document?

patterns: what can counsel do on the platform
entries.answer: Counsel is a read-only admin. You can browse every admin page, comment/redline on any legal doc, tick off the counsel review checklist, and reset your own password. You cannot: publish agreement versions, ratify or revoke, apply a roundtrip, delete comments, rebuild .docx bundles, or edit source markdown. Those actions belong to Birthright's Executive Director — which is why we recommend emailing instead of clicking.
entries.follow_up_label: How do I start reviewing?
